paragraphs: 6 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Wednesday for 6 clubs across 5 levels, with Drew Thorpe producing the night's most notable performance.
Drew Thorpe started on the mound for Charlotte Knights.
Drew Thorpe worked 5.0 innings, allowing 5 hits and 2 earned runs, with 2 walks and 6 strikeouts.
One of his strikeouts came in the second on a 1-2 94 mph four-seam fastball, when he put away Anthony Volpe.

Steven Brooks started on the mound for Portland Sea Dogs. He worked 2 2/3 innings, allowing 2 hits and 1 earned run, with 1 walk and 5 strikeouts. One of his strikeouts came in the first on a 1-2 pitch, when he put away Bryan Rincon. Portland Sea Dogs beat Reading Fightin Phils, 6-4.
Alejandro Garza went 2-for-5, 1 run scored, 1 stolen base for Hill City Howlers at Single-A. He batted first and started at second base. Hill City Howlers beat Charleston RiverDogs, 4-3.
Zach Daudet went 2-for-3, 1 run scored, 1 walk for Asheville Tourists at High-A. He batted sixth and started at shortstop. Asheville Tourists beat Brooklyn Cyclones, 7-6.

Brooks Lee went 1-for-4, 1 RBI for Minnesota Twins. Brooks Lee drove in his lone run with a single in the seventh to center field on a 0-2 83 mph slider from Dylan Lee. He batted seventh and started at third base. Minnesota Twins beat Atlanta Braves, 6-4.

Taylor Dollard started on the mound for Everett AquaSox. He worked 5 1/3 innings, allowing 6 hits and 4 earned runs, with 2 walks and 4 strikeouts. One of his strikeouts came in the third on a 2-2 pitch, when he put away Harold Coll. Everett AquaSox fell to Tri-City Dust Devils, 3-4.
title: Drew Thorpe turns in a strong outing on the mound
